data.rationale: The proposal follows the right sequence (Gutenberg search, then Wikipedia author lookup, then a Notes entry with the correct format), but it treats author as something noted from the book page instead of an input, omits the release date capture and the "do not download" constraint, and leaves out the tab switches and the "open the article" step. That leaves a builder to guess how to find the right book and article, though the note template is clear.
